## Problem and behavior

What concrete problem does this change solve, and what happens afterward?

## Compatibility

Describe affected contracts, consumers and version/pin changes. Omit inapplicable details.

## Validation

List executed commands, tested source SHA and actual results, including blocked checks.

## Delivery and recovery

When applicable, give the release/artifact identity, migration and safe rollback/forward fix.
Keep credentials, private endpoints, production records and personal data out of the PR.
